In June 2025, equity listing figures have been revised to include every type of listing, including those that do not affect the overall number of equity issuers listed on Euronext. Listings are initial public offerings, private placements, direct listings, transfers between Euronext markets e.g. from Euronext Access to Euronext Growth, mergers and reverse mergers, business combinations and de-SPACs, as well as cross-listings.
